## LLM013 Model/vector store call in a loop

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | warning |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://github.com/pgy763/llm-lint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#llm013 |
| Turn it off | `LLM013: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM013` on the command line |

Model and vector store time is almost all network round trips. One call per loop iteration means 10 items is 10 RTTs: latency adds up linearly, while a batch API can often take them in one go.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM013` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm013 -->

## What it looks like

A model or vector-store call inside a `for` / `while` / `stream().map(...)` over data rows.

## How to fix

Batch instead: one prompt with all items, or the embedding API's batch call. N calls means N times the latency and the bill.
